_doc: doc 07 §6 month-end anchors (UTC). Each boundary = anchor + k months, day clamped to the target month's length, computed from the ORIGINAL anchor (never chained). Monthly anchor 2026-01-31 15:00: Feb 2026 has 28 days -> Feb 28; Mar has 31 -> Mar 31 (not Mar 28, which chaining would give); Apr has 30 -> Apr 30; May -> May 31. 2028 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not by 100) -> Feb 29. Yearly anchor 2028-02-29: 2029/2030/2031 are not leap -> Feb 28; 2032 is leap -> Feb 29 again. period_index: the period flips exactly at the boundary instant (2026-02-28T15:00:00Z starts period 1; one second earlier is still period 0).
